summary: Risk sentiment is mixed to slightly defensive today: Reuters shows stocks wobbling, yields rising, oil firming, and crypto slipping, while some altcoin coverage still flags selective upside in names tied to catalysts. The clearest bullish pockets are in privacy and exchange/narrative altcoins, while BTC, ETH, and several large-cap markets look pressured by higher rates and geopolitics.[9][12]
